A1.justification: The PDFs describe the same scoping review, with the same authors, research questions, and 57-study corpus. Both are readable through their references; neither contains a separate appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original descriptive analysis of the selected literature, including annual study counts and attack/defense distributions in Section 3.2 and Figure 3.

after.justification: v2 retains this original analysis of the review corpus in Section 3.3 and Figure 4. These review-generated results are distinct from experiments attributed to cited studies.

M1.justification: The same review framework and ten proposed privacy-preserving characteristics remain. Added descriptions of existing XAI techniques and attack notation introduce no new proposed algorithm, model, or inference procedure.

E1.justification: Both analyze the same 57 studies covering January 2019–December 2024. New background on concept-based, probing, neuron-activation, and mechanistic interpretability methods does not establish additional training or evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Neither version evaluates comparison methods against an implemented method of its own. The expanded literature discussion adds no experimentally evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 3.1 retains the databases, search string, publication window, search date, eligibility criteria, and selection counts. Newly documented researcher responsibilities clarify the existing process without establishing a revised protocol.

E4.justification: The three illustrative loan-application cases in Table 4 are retained. Neither version adds ablations, robustness experiments, or completed evaluations of the proposed characteristics; the added design guidance is prospective.

E5.justification: Neither version reports uncertainty estimates, significance tests, repeated-run statistics, or inter-rater agreement for its review analyses. Newly described verification by another researcher does not introduce a statistical estimation procedure.

E6.justification: The study counts and research-trend distributions remain unchanged. Table 3 revises one concrete study–method association: MDAV microaggregation with TreeSHAP changes from Abbasi et al. ([1] in v1) to Bozorgpanah and Torra, aligning the table with Section 5.3.

T1.justification: Section 4 adds explicit model/explanation notation and Equations (1)–(8) defining prediction-based and explanation-based attack mappings. v1 described these attacks verbally and diagrammatically; no theorems or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the three research questions and central contributions: reviewing privacy risks, categorizing preservation methods, and proposing privacy-preserving XAI characteristics. The principal claims are not materially strengthened or narrowed.

C2.justification: New Section 7.2 adds practical safeguards such as query limits, logging, and access-dependent threat considerations; Section 7.4 adds chain-of-thought privacy directions. Some earlier distinctions, including training-class inference within model inversion, are dropped, while the central privacy–utility interpretations remain.

D1.justification: Section 3.1 newly documents librarian-assisted search design, researcher responsibilities, independent full-text verification by a second researcher, and joint verification of study additions/removals. These improve procedural transparency without demonstrating that the review was rerun.

R1.justification: The background adds four XAI categories and their supporting literature. Section 2.4 substantially expands positioning against overlapping reviews, including Baniecki and Biecek, Noppel and Wressnegger, and Nguyen et al. (2025), beyond the general XAI surveys discussed in v1.

P1.justification: Prose is extensively rewritten across the background, risk review, preservation methods, and discussion. Assets/actors become a threat-model section, the taxonomy moves into Section 3, and challenges and recommendations become separate sections. Citation style also changes to author–year.

P2.justification: Diagrams are extensively redrawn in color, including the threat model and attack illustrations; the separate lifecycle figure is removed and the taxonomy reorganized. Table 1 expands, tables are reformatted, and typography and page layout change throughout. The trend panels redisplay the existing analysis.

improvement.justification: Clearer screening disclosures, comparison with closely related reviews, and practical design guidance improve transparency and usefulness. Condensing Section 4 loses some scope detail, but the additions support a modest net gain; the review corpus and quantitative evidence remain essentially unchanged.
